# has worked with

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasWorkedWith`](gmeow-hasWorkedWith.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasWorkedWith>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/contacts`](../../slices/contacts.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Records that two agents have worked together; symmetric. The period is carried with gmeow:validFrom/validUntil on the statement, or reified as a [`gmeow:ProfessionalRelationship`](../classes/gmeow-ProfessionalRelationship.md).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the flat shortcut to record that two agents have worked together, when the bare symmetric fact (optionally with a period on the statement) suffices.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it when the collaboration must bear its own interval, confidence, or evidence — reify it as a [`gmeow:ProfessionalRelationship`](../classes/gmeow-ProfessionalRelationship.md) — and avoid asserting it in both directions (it is symmetric).

### How to use

- Assert the symmetric edge between two [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) instances; carry the period with gmeow:validFrom/validUntil on the statement, or promote to [`gmeow:ProfessionalRelationship`](../classes/gmeow-ProfessionalRelationship.md) when first-class structure is needed.

### Examples

- ex:lillith [`gmeow:hasWorkedWith`](gmeow-hasWorkedWith.md) ex:morgan.
